	# Material-shortage handling remains disabled until the game exposes
	# a stable building_type -> goods market scope combination.
	always = yes

	# Shared CMM price gates are applied by the common candidate checks.

	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.var:eu5ab_global_budget_remaining >= building_base_cost_in_gold

	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.gold >= eu5ab_cash_required_shipbuilding
}

	# Material-shortage handling remains disabled until the game exposes
	# a stable building_type -> goods market scope combination.
	always = yes
}

	# Shared CMM price gates are applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_luxury_goods_has_budget = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.var:eu5ab_global_budget_remaining >= building_base_cost_in_gold
}

	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.gold >= eu5ab_cash_required_luxury_goods
}

	# The shared CMM shortage gate is applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_template_slot_1_price_in_range = {
	# Shared CMM price gates are applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_template_slot_1_keeps_cash_reserve = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.gold >= eu5ab_cash_required_template_slot_1
}

eu5ab_template_slot_1_has_budget = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.var:eu5ab_global_budget_remaining >= building_base_cost_in_gold
}

            AND = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner = { eu5ab_manual_month_current = yes } eu5ab_template_slot_2_building_allowed_manual = yes }

eu5ab_template_slot_20_has_input_materials = {
	# The shared CMM shortage gate is applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_template_slot_20_price_in_range = {
	# Shared CMM price gates are applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_template_slot_20_keeps_cash_reserve = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.gold >= eu5ab_cash_required_template_slot_20
}

eu5ab_template_slot_20_has_budget = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.var:eu5ab_global_budget_remaining >= building_base_cost_in_gold
}


# Reject a candidate before approval if its actual vanilla material mix
# would cross the construction-stall headroom or an extreme price ceiling.
eu5ab_engine_construction_materials_available = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_construction_demand_books > 0 }

# GUI-only actual values are passed as fixed-value scopes by the hidden bridge.
# Candidate classes are mutually exclusive: replacement upgrade, from-zero new build,
# or another level of an existing ordinary building.
eu5ab_candidate_is_upgrade = {
	eu5ab_candidate_replaces_existing_building = yes
}

eu5ab_candidate_is_new_build = {
	NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_replaces_existing_building = yes }
	eu5ab_candidate_lacks_existing_building = yes
}

eu5ab_candidate_produces_food = {
	OR = {
		OR = { eu5ab_output_supports_beeswax = yes eu5ab_output_supports_fish = yes eu5ab_output_supports_fruit = yes eu5ab_output_supports_fur = yes eu5ab_output_supports_legumes = yes eu5ab_output_supports_livestock = yes eu5ab_output_supports_maize = yes eu5ab_output_supports_millet = yes eu5ab_output_supports_olives = yes eu5ab_output_supports_potato = yes eu5ab_output_supports_rice = yes eu5ab_output_supports_wheat = yes eu5ab_output_supports_wild_game = yes }
		this = building_type:irrigation_systems
	}
}

# The two existing food switches own both parts of emergency response:
# priority over non-food work and the ordinary-building return-metric bypass.
eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = { OR = {
        AND = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_quote_restored eu5ab_batch_quote_food_emergency > 0 }
        AND = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_quote_restored }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_emergency_food_exhaustion_override > 0
			market ?= { is_projected_to_run_out_of_food_stockpile = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_emergency_food_stockpile_override > 0
			market ?= { market_food_percentage <= 0.25 }
		}
	}
 }
    } }

# Eight queue phases implement the exact four-feature order twice:
# food-emergency ranks 1-4 first, then normal ranks 1-4 as phases 5-8.
eu5ab_engine_candidate_in_current_priority_phase = {
	OR = {
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 1 eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_1 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 2 eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_2 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 3 eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_3 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 4 eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_4 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 5 NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_1 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 6 NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_2 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 7 NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_3 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 8 NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_4 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 9 eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_1 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 10 eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_2 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 11 eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_3 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 12 eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_4 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 13 NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_1 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 14 NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_2 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 15 NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_3 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 16 NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_4 = yes }
	}
}

eu5ab_rgo_in_current_priority_phase = {
	OR = {
		AND = { owner.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 1 owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 1 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
		AND = { owner.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 2 owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 2 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
		AND = { owner.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 3 owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 3 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
		AND = { owner.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 4 owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 4 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
		AND = { owner.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 5 owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 1 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
		AND = { owner.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 6 owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 2 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
		AND = { owner.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 7 owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 3 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
		AND = { owner.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 8 owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 4 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
	}
}

eu5ab_engine_candidate_passes_selected_metric = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_global_economic_metric }
					eu5ab_manual_value_global_economic_metric = 1
				}
			}
			scope:eu5ab_engine_income > 0
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_manual_value_global_economic_metric = 2 }
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit > 0
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_manual_value_global_economic_metric = 3 }
			scope:eu5ab_engine_income >= {
				value = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost
				multiply = 0.05
				divide = 12
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_manual_value_global_economic_metric = 4 }
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit >= {
				value = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost
				multiply = 0.05
				divide = 12
			}
		}
	}
}

# Emergency demand is deliberately separate from candidate ranking. Each
# reason has its own CMM switch and can bypass only the selected return metric.
eu5ab_engine_candidate_uses_emergency_override = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_recipe_expected_output_value > 0
	NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_passes_selected_metric = yes }
	eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_emergency_demand = yes
}

eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_emergency_demand = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country.eu5ab_manual_value_global_emergency_food_exhaustion_override > 0
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
				OR = { eu5ab_output_supports_beeswax = yes eu5ab_output_supports_fish = yes eu5ab_output_supports_fruit = yes eu5ab_output_supports_fur = yes eu5ab_output_supports_legumes = yes eu5ab_output_supports_livestock = yes eu5ab_output_supports_maize = yes eu5ab_output_supports_millet = yes eu5ab_output_supports_olives = yes eu5ab_output_supports_potato = yes eu5ab_output_supports_rice = yes eu5ab_output_supports_wheat = yes eu5ab_output_supports_wild_game = yes }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market ?= { is_projected_to_run_out_of_food_stockpile = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country.eu5ab_manual_value_global_emergency_food_stockpile_override > 0
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
				OR = { eu5ab_output_supports_beeswax = yes eu5ab_output_supports_fish = yes eu5ab_output_supports_fruit = yes eu5ab_output_supports_fur = yes eu5ab_output_supports_legumes = yes eu5ab_output_supports_livestock = yes eu5ab_output_supports_maize = yes eu5ab_output_supports_millet = yes eu5ab_output_supports_olives = yes eu5ab_output_supports_potato = yes eu5ab_output_supports_rice = yes eu5ab_output_supports_wheat = yes eu5ab_output_supports_wild_game = yes }

eu5ab_engine_candidate_economically_sound = {
	scope:eu5ab_engine_cost > 0
	OR = {
		# Infrastructure without a production recipe has no comparable return metric.
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_recipe_expected_output_value <= 0
		eu5ab_engine_candidate_passes_selected_metric = yes
		eu5ab_engine_candidate_uses_emergency_override = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_actual_budget = {
	owner = {
		var:eu5ab_global_budget_remaining >= {
			value = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost
			add = var:eu5ab_q_planned_budget
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_engine_candidate_keeps_actual_cash_reserve = {
	owner = {
		gold >= {
			value = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost
			add = var:eu5ab_q_planned_spend
			add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_current_min_cash_reserve
		}
	}
}

# Location scope. Demand is independent of emergency priority switches.
eu5ab_irrigation_food_demand = {
	exists = market
	market = {
		OR = {
			is_projected_to_run_out_of_food_stockpile = yes
			market_food_percentage <= 0.25
			AND = {
				market_food_percentage <= 0.5
				market_monthly_food_balance < 0
			}
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_irrigation_population_demand = {
	# Guard undefined/zero capacity before reading the native fraction.
	location_max_population > 0
	location_population_percentage >= 0.9
}

# Building-type scope. Other buildings retain their existing eligibility rules.
eu5ab_candidate_has_irrigation_demand = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { this = building_type:irrigation_systems }
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
			OR = {
				eu5ab_irrigation_population_demand = yes
				eu5ab_irrigation_food_demand = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Building-type scope. Both granaries share province storage and preservation rules.
eu5ab_is_granary = {
	OR = {
		this = building_type:granary
		this = building_type:village_granary
	}
}

# Existence of the capital's market distinguishes unknown from a genuine zero.
eu5ab_location_food_price_known = { exists = province.capital.market }
# Granaries expand PROVINCE storage, not market food output.
# A final partial level is allowed; the next pass stops at the six-month target.
eu5ab_granary_storage_demand = {
	exists = province
	province = {
		province_max_food > 0
		province_food_percentage >= 0.75
		province_max_food < scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_province_food_reserve_target
	}
}

eu5ab_granary_project_pending = {
	province = {
		any_location_in_province = {
			OR = {
				any_buildings_in_location = {
					OR = {
						building_type = building_type:granary
						building_type = building_type:village_granary
					}
					building_levels_under_construction > 0
				}
				AND = {
					owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active }
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_types target = building_type:granary }
					NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_confirmed_types target = building_type:granary } }
				}
				AND = {
					owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active }
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_types target = building_type:village_granary }
					NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_confirmed_types target = building_type:village_granary } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_candidate_storage_project_available = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { eu5ab_is_granary = yes }
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { eu5ab_granary_project_pending = yes } }
	}
}

eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_demand = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { eu5ab_is_granary = yes }
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
			OR = { eu5ab_granary_storage_demand = yes eu5ab_granary_monthly_food_saved > 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Expansion needs a refill surplus; decay-only projects need a positive 5% annual return.
# Exports must not hide local surplus which could refill the added storage instead.
eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_food_balance = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { eu5ab_is_granary = yes }
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { eu5ab_granary_storage_demand = yes }
				OR = {
					AND = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_province_food_balance scope:eu5ab_engine_province_food_balance > 0 }
					AND = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_province_food_natural scope:eu5ab_engine_province_food_natural > 0 }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { eu5ab_location_food_price_known = yes }
				exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_profit
				exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_location_food_price > 0
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
					eu5ab_granary_monthly_food_saved > 0
					eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit > 0
					eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit >= { value = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost multiply = 0.05 divide = 12 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# A producing local grain RGO and a reason to increase that crop are required.
# Its separate final return gate uses native sale revenue and recipe operating costs.
eu5ab_windmill_output_demand = {
	exists = market
	raw_material_output > 0
	OR = {
		AND = {
			raw_material = goods:wheat
			OR = {
				eu5ab_irrigation_food_demand = yes
				market = {
					"goods_supply_in_market(goods:wheat)" < "goods_demand_in_market(goods:wheat)"
				}
				market = {
					"market_price(goods:wheat)" > {
						value = "default_price(goods:wheat)"
						multiply = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_price_max divide = 100 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			raw_material = goods:rice
			OR = {
				eu5ab_irrigation_food_demand = yes
				market = {
					"goods_supply_in_market(goods:rice)" < "goods_demand_in_market(goods:rice)"
				}
				market = {
					"market_price(goods:rice)" > {
						value = "default_price(goods:rice)"
						multiply = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_price_max divide = 100 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			raw_material = goods:millet
			OR = {
				eu5ab_irrigation_food_demand = yes
				market = {
					"goods_supply_in_market(goods:millet)" < "goods_demand_in_market(goods:millet)"
				}
				market = {
					"market_price(goods:millet)" > {
						value = "default_price(goods:millet)"
						multiply = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_price_max divide = 100 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_demand = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { this = building_type:windmill }
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { eu5ab_windmill_output_demand = yes }
	}
}

eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_return = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { this = building_type:windmill }
		AND = {
			exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_rgo_revenue
			exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_profit
			exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost
			scope:eu5ab_engine_rgo_revenue > 0
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				eu5ab_windmill_output_factor > 0
				eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit > 0
				OR = {
					owner = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_global_economic_metric } eu5ab_manual_value_global_economic_metric < 3 } }
					eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit >= { value = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost multiply = 0.05 divide = 12 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Compare the last fixed-point unit exactly without multiplying large readings.
# On the equality branch slice * divisor cannot exceed the original limit.
eu5ab_capacity_below_stop = {
    OR = {
        eu5ab_capacity_overage < eu5ab_capacity_hard_slice
        AND = {
            eu5ab_capacity_overage = eu5ab_capacity_hard_slice
            eu5ab_capacity_limit_value > { value = eu5ab_capacity_overage multiply = 10 }
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_capacity_no_discount = {
    OR = {
        eu5ab_capacity_headroom > eu5ab_capacity_soft_slice
        AND = {
            eu5ab_capacity_headroom = eu5ab_capacity_soft_slice
            eu5ab_capacity_limit_value <= { value = eu5ab_capacity_headroom multiply = 20 }
        }
    }
}
# Building type scope. No employment means no structural occupancy, not merely
# an empty workforce today. The replacement trigger also checks its source type.
eu5ab_candidate_capacity_exempt = {
    OR = {
        employment_size <= 0
        eu5ab_candidate_replaces_capacity_building = yes
    }
}
eu5ab_candidate_has_capacity = {
    OR = {
        scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_open }
        eu5ab_candidate_capacity_exempt = yes
    }
}
# The view is valid only for the country and monthly scan that built it.
# Old saves and non-worker callers deliberately fail this check and keep the
# former full native-recipe scan as their compatibility fallback.
eu5ab_active_recipe_catalog_current = {
    has_variable = eu5ab_active_recipe_catalog_ready
    exists = var:eu5ab_active_recipe_catalog_country
    var:eu5ab_active_recipe_catalog_country = owner
    var:eu5ab_active_recipe_catalog_month = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_month
    var:eu5ab_active_recipe_catalog_year = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_year
    owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active eu5ab_scan_month_current = yes }
}
# Closed locations still need recipes when at least one active zero-employment
# or real upgrade candidate can pass the capacity gate.
eu5ab_active_recipe_capture_needed = {
    OR = {
        NOT = { eu5ab_active_recipe_catalog_current = yes }
        AND = {
            has_variable_list = eu5ab_active_recipe_catalog_view
            OR = {
                has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_open
                any_in_list = {
                    variable = eu5ab_active_recipe_catalog_view
                    eu5ab_candidate_capacity_exempt = yes
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
# GUI validation has the exact native predecessor for this destination.
eu5ab_engine_candidate_capacity_exempt = {
    OR = {
        scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { employment_size <= 0 }
        AND = {
            exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_replaced_building
            scope:eu5ab_engine_replaced_building = {
                building_level >= 1
                eu5ab_upgrade_source_available = yes
                building_can_be_upgraded_by = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                building_type = { employment_size > 0 }
            }
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_capacity = {
    OR = {
        has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_open
        eu5ab_engine_candidate_capacity_exempt = yes
    }
}
# Approval already checked capacity; firing only refreshes the cash hold.
eu5ab_approved_candidate_keeps_cash_reserve = {
    has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire_quote_ready
    owner = { gold >= {
        value = eu5ab_q_planned_spend_value
        add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_current_min_cash_reserve
    } }
}
eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_capacity_now = {
    OR = {
        eu5ab_engine_candidate_capacity_exempt = yes
        AND = {
            exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_capacity_used
            scope:eu5ab_engine_capacity_used >= 0
            modifier:free_building_levels > 0
            OR = {
                eu5ab_engine_capacity_input_overage < eu5ab_engine_capacity_input_slice
                AND = {
                    eu5ab_engine_capacity_input_overage = eu5ab_engine_capacity_input_slice
                    modifier:free_building_levels > { value = eu5ab_engine_capacity_input_overage multiply = 10 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_recipe_catalog_view target = building_type:yamashiro }
				}
			}
		}
		building_type:zhixian = {
			scope:eu5ab_native_recipe_location = {
				OR = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_recipe_catalog_view target = building_type:zhixian }
				}
			}
		}
		fallback = { always = no }
	}
}

eu5ab_quote_context_current = {
    exists = var:eu5ab_quote_country owner ?= var:eu5ab_quote_country
    has_variable = eu5ab_quote_ticket has_variable = eu5ab_quote_month has_variable = eu5ab_quote_year
    owner ?= { eu5ab_scan_month_current = yes
        var:eu5ab_scan_month = prev.var:eu5ab_quote_month
        var:eu5ab_scan_year = prev.var:eu5ab_quote_year }
}

# Static job demand is exact for the selected building type and upgrade.
# The forward gate adds vanilla promotion modifiers for the configured
# 0-240 month horizon and caps the result by eligible source populations.
# Net-new jobs is generated non-negative, so the availability comparison
# also accepts zero-job upgrades without evaluating net-new jobs twice.
eu5ab_candidate_current_workforce_sufficient = {
	eu5ab_candidate_current_available_workers >= eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs
}

eu5ab_candidate_projected_workforce_sufficient = {
	eu5ab_candidate_projected_available_workers >= eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs
}

# Cross-template safety gates.
eu5ab_has_local_workforce = {
	OR = {
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_pause_low_workforce <= 0
		eu5ab_candidate_projected_workforce_sufficient = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_upstream_output_shortage = {
	switch = {
		trigger = this
		fallback = { always = no }

					OR = { AND = { OR = { eu5ab_recipe_tools_workshop_0_selected = 1 } OR = { AND = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { eu5ab_native_recipes_current = yes is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_native_recipe_types target = building_type:tools_workshop } has_variable_map = eu5ab_native_recipe_slot_0 AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_native_recipe_slot_0 trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_native_recipe_slot_0 } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_native_recipe_slot_0 target = building_type:tools_workshop } } } } } NOT = { OR = { always = no } } } } }
					eu5ab_market_upstream_shortage_tools = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	OR = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_pending_data_ready = yes } eu5ab_upstream_output_shortage = yes }

# RGO gates are split so the monthly diagnostics can classify every
# deeply-scored location by its first blocking condition.
eu5ab_rgo_capacity_available = {
	is_full_expanded_rgo = no
}

eu5ab_rgo_location_available = {
	eu5ab_location_has_parallel_room = yes
	NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
	OR = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown } owner = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_active } }
}

eu5ab_rgo_enabled = {
	owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_enabled > 0
	owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_allow_rgo > 0
	eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
}

# Do not invent a price for unsupported/missing cost inputs.
eu5ab_rgo_cost_inputs_available = {
	exists = owner
	exists = market
	exists = raw_material
	"default_price(raw_material)" > 0
	"default_price(goods:lumber)" > 0
	"default_price(goods:masonry)" > 0
	raw_material = {
		OR = {
			goods_method = mining
			goods_method = farming
			goods_method = hunting
			goods_method = gathering
			goods_method = forestry
		}
	}
	owner.inflation >= 0
	eu5ab_rgo_category_cost_multiplier > 0
}

eu5ab_rgo_finance_available = {
	eu5ab_rgo_cost_inputs_available = yes
	owner.gold >= eu5ab_rgo_cash_required
	owner.eu5ab_global_budget_remaining_value > 0
	owner.var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick < { value = owner.var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota }
}

eu5ab_rgo_utilization_allowed = {
	rgo_workers >= eu5ab_rgo_current_capacity
}

# One RGO level always adds the vanilla rgo_level workforce demand.
# The strict gate evaluates that prospective level, not merely whether
# the currently built RGO is staffed.
eu5ab_rgo_projected_workforce_sufficient = {
	eu5ab_rgo_projected_available_workers >= eu5ab_rgo_jobs_per_expansion
}

eu5ab_rgo_workforce_allowed = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_population_mode = yes }
		eu5ab_rgo_projected_workforce_sufficient = yes
	}
}

    has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_ready exists = var:eu5ab_rgo_queue_owner
    has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_day has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_civil
    trigger_if = { limit = {
        has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_ready exists = var:eu5ab_rgo_queue_owner
        has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_day has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_civil

        owner = var:eu5ab_rgo_queue_owner

    }

        has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_request_day has_variable_list = eu5ab_rgo_queue_tickets }

    }

# The native duration is a first staffing-inspection time, never proof of completion.
# Older, already-completed records can proceed without inventing a past date.

    NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_wait_construction }
    OR = {
        eu5ab_rgos_under_construction = 0
        AND = {
            has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_baseline
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_baseline }
                rgo_level > var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_baseline
            }
        }
    }
}

    var:eu5ab_parallel_limit = eu5ab_parallel_next_slot_value
    var:eu5ab_parallel_occupied = num_civil_constructions
    var:eu5ab_parallel_modifier = modifier:max_constructions_at_same_time

                    eu5ab_candidate_output_limits_allow = yes } } } }
        AND = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_quote_restored } }
    eu5ab_candidate_production_cooldown_clear = yes

eu5ab_scan_month_current = {
    has_variable = eu5ab_scan_year has_variable = eu5ab_scan_month
    var:eu5ab_scan_year = current_year OR = { AND = { current_month = 1 var:eu5ab_scan_month = 1 } AND = { current_month = 2 var:eu5ab_scan_month = 2 } AND = { current_month = 3 var:eu5ab_scan_month = 3 } AND = { current_month = 4 var:eu5ab_scan_month = 4 } AND = { current_month = 5 var:eu5ab_scan_month = 5 } AND = { current_month = 6 var:eu5ab_scan_month = 6 } AND = { current_month = 7 var:eu5ab_scan_month = 7 } AND = { current_month = 8 var:eu5ab_scan_month = 8 } AND = { current_month = 9 var:eu5ab_scan_month = 9 } AND = { current_month = 10 var:eu5ab_scan_month = 10 } AND = { current_month = 11 var:eu5ab_scan_month = 11 } AND = { current_month = 12 var:eu5ab_scan_month = 12 } }
}
eu5ab_scan_calendar_open = { OR = { current_day = 2 current_day = 3 current_day = 4 current_day = 5 current_day = 6 current_day = 7 current_day = 8 current_day = 9 current_day = 10 current_day = 11 current_day = 12 current_day = 13 current_day = 14 current_day = 15 current_day = 16 current_day = 17 current_day = 18 current_day = 19 current_day = 20 current_day = 21 current_day = 22 } }
eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = { OR = {
        eu5ab_manual_physical_calendar = yes
        AND = { has_variable = eu5ab_manual_computing eu5ab_manual_month_current = yes }
    } }

# Building scope. Snapshot lifetime is the location scan request.
eu5ab_upgrade_source_sampled = {
    location = {
        exists = var:eu5ab_upgrade_snapshot_owner
        is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_upgrade_sampled_sources target = prev }
        has_variable_map = eu5ab_upgrade_source_civil
        has_variable_map = eu5ab_upgrade_source_levels
        # A missing/zero entry is not a readable event target. Empty queues
        # already prove availability and need no sampled job credit.
        trigger_if = { limit = {
            exists = var:eu5ab_upgrade_snapshot_owner
            has_variable_map = eu5ab_upgrade_source_civil
            has_variable_map = eu5ab_upgrade_source_levels
        }
            AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_upgrade_source_civil trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_upgrade_source_civil } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_upgrade_source_civil target = prev } } }
            AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_upgrade_source_levels trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_upgrade_source_levels } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_upgrade_source_levels target = prev } } }
            trigger_if = { limit = {
                AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_upgrade_source_civil trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_upgrade_source_civil } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_upgrade_source_civil target = prev } } }
                AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_upgrade_source_levels trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_upgrade_source_levels } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_upgrade_source_levels target = prev } } }
            }
                owner = var:eu5ab_upgrade_snapshot_owner
                "variable_map(eu5ab_upgrade_source_civil|prev)" = num_civil_constructions
                "variable_map(eu5ab_upgrade_source_levels|prev)" = prev.building_level
            }
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_upgrade_source_available = {
    building_level >= 1
    OR = {
        location = { num_civil_constructions = 0 }
        AND = { eu5ab_upgrade_source_sampled = yes building_level > eu5ab_upgrade_reserved_count }
    }
}

eu5ab_industry_snapshot_current = {
        has_variable = eu5ab_industry_ready
        exists = var:eu5ab_industry_owner
        owner = var:eu5ab_industry_owner
        has_variable = eu5ab_industry_ticket
        has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_request
        var:eu5ab_industry_ticket = var:eu5ab_capacity_request
        var:eu5ab_capacity_month = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_month
        var:eu5ab_capacity_year = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_year
        owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active eu5ab_scan_month_current = yes }
    }

        AND = { NOT = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_screen_active AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_inputs trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_inputs } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_inputs target = prev } } } } } eu5ab_inputs_available_worker_live = yes }

eu5ab_location_template_not_paused_live = {
	NOT = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				eu5ab_manual_policy_value = 1
				owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_preset_granary_paused }
			}
			AND = {
				eu5ab_manual_policy_value = 2
				owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_preset_industrial_zone_paused }
			}
			AND = {
				eu5ab_manual_policy_value = 3
				owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_preset_trade_center_paused }
			}
			AND = {
				eu5ab_manual_policy_value = 4
				owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_preset_naval_base_paused }
